description: This file contains functions for parsing, rendering, and manipulating Markdown content, including handling code blocks, headers, lists, notes, and other Markdown elements. It is part of a utility module for processing Markdown in a larger project.

methods.name: flattenWrappedLines
methods.description: Flattens wrapped lines in Markdown content, handling code blocks and special syntax.

methods.name: buildTree
methods.description: Builds a Markdown node tree from lines of Markdown text, recognizing headers, lists, code blocks, notes, and properties.

methods.name: parseCodeBlockMetadata
methods.description: Parses metadata from code block lines, extracting language, title, and highlight info.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main function to parse Markdown content into a node tree.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a Markdown node tree back into Markdown text with formatting options.

methods.name: visitAll
methods.description: Visits all nodes in a Markdown node tree with a visitor function.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Recursively visits a node and its children with a visitor function.

methods.name: filterNodesForLanguage
methods.description: Filters Markdown nodes to include only those matching a specified language in 'langs:' list.

methods.name: wrapText
methods.description: Wraps text to a maximum column width with optional flattening.
